final_answer:
I have gathered comprehensive information about Hugging Face's pricing plans. Here is my summary:

# Hugging Face Pricing Plans Summary

Hugging Face offers three main subscription plans for individuals and organizations, plus separate usage-based pricing for storage, Spaces hardware, and Inference Endpoints.

## 1. PRO Account — $9/month
**Tagline:** "Boost your personal HF experience"
**Advantages:**
- 10× private storage capacity
- 2× public storage capacity
- 20× included inference credits
- 8× ZeroGPU quota and highest queue priority
- Host ZeroGPU, Gradio & Docker Spaces
- Spaces Dev Mode (fast iterations via SSH/VS Code)
- Personal blog publishing
- Dataset Viewer for private datasets
- Show your support with a PRO badge
- Get early access to upcoming features (Features Preview)

## 2. Team — $20/month per user (Most Popular)
**Tagline:** "Instant setup for growing teams"
**Advantages:**
- SSO support (SAML & OIDC)
- Data location control with Storage Regions
- Detailed action reviews with Audit Logs
- Granular access control via Resource Groups
- Repository usage Analytics
- Advanced auth policies and repository visibility controls
- Centralized token control and approvals
- Dataset Viewer for private datasets
- Create Gradio & Docker Spaces, with advanced compute options
- All organization members get ZeroGPU and Inference Providers PRO benefits

## 3. Enterprise — $50/month per user
**Tagline:** "Custom onboarding and enterprise features"
**Advantages:**
- All benefits from the Team plan
- Highest storage, bandwidth, and API rate limits
- Automated user management with SCIM provisioning
- Advanced security and access controls
- Managed billing with annual commitments
- Legal and Compliance processes
- Dedicated support

---

## Additional Pricing Information

### Storage (volume-based, egress/CDN included)
- AWS S3: $23/TB/month
- Backblaze Overdrive: $15/TB/month
- **HF Hub tiers:**
  - Base: $12/TB/mo (public), $18/TB/mo (private)
  - 50TB+ (-20%): $10/TB/mo (public), $16/TB/mo (private)
  - 200TB+ (-25%): $9/TB/mo (public), $14/TB/mo (private)
  - 500TB+ (-33%): $8/TB/mo (public), $12/TB/mo (private)

### Spaces Hardware (on-demand GPUs)
- CPU Basic: Free
- CPU Upgrade: $0.03/hour
- ZeroGPU (Nvidia RTX Pro 6000): Free
- Various Nvidia T4, L4, L40S, A10G, A100, H100, H200, B200 configurations ranging from $0.40 to $74.00/hour

### Inference Endpoints
- Starting at $0.033/hour
- Available on AWS, Azure, and GCP
- CPU, GPU (T4, L4, L40S, A100, H100, H200, B200, RTX PRO 6000), and accelerator (AWS Inferentia2, TPU v5e) options

The free Hub tier (default, no cost) is also available with sign-up, giving access to explore, experiment, collaborate, and build ML technology.
